read.thesis: Chubb's Q2 P&C combined ratio of 83.8% and 18.8% underwriting income growth mask soft property and casualty pricing; NA Commercial premiums fell 2.3% as property underwriting actions cut growth.

triggers.label: Soft property and casualty conditions
triggers.quote: overly soft underwriting conditions persist in certain areas of property insurance globally, particularly large account and E&S related

triggers.label: Softness spreading to casualty
triggers.quote: soft market conditions are spreading to certain areas of casualty while financial lines also remain soft

red_flags.label: Growth penalty from property underwriting actions; soft casualty and financial lines
red_flags.quote: The growth penalty we are paying in property will dissipate going forward.
